SELECT q.question_id AS questionId, q.title, q.difficulty, u.nick_name AS creatorName, q.create_time AS createTime FROM tb_question q LEFT JOIN tb_sys_user u ON q.create_by = u.user_id
AND q.difficulty = #{query.difficulty}
AND q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_question_tag qt INNER JOIN tb_tag t ON t.tag_id = qt.tag_id AND t.delete_state = 0 WHERE qt.question_id = q.question_id AND t.category = #{query.tagCategory} AND qt.delete_state = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_question_tag qt WHERE qt.question_id = q.question_id AND qt.tag_id = #{query.tagId} AND qt.delete_state = 0 )
ORDER BY q.create_time DESC, q.question_id DESC
